name: duopore-public-record-join-reconcile
description: Match two lists by reference and spot missing rows or values that disagree.

interface.longDescription: Match two lists by reference and spot missing rows or values that disagree. Share both lists with a unique reference for each row. See which records match, which appear on only one side, and which labels or values differ. Both lists must use the same units and meaning for the values. Repeated join references need fixing first.
defaultPrompt: Match these two lists by reference and show the gaps.
Which values disagree between these two record lists?
